ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

3. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. happiness

4. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

5. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

6. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.

7. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

8. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

9. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.

10. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

11. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.

12. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Where is the library?

2. B — One main idea with supporting sentences

3. B — run

4. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

5. A — A person, place, thing, or idea

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

7. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

8. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

9. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

10. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

11. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Punctuation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive Listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Word Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
